notes: Summary: Mid-market CCaaS provider building real-time agent assist as a core differentiator for upsell into banking customers.
Main ask: streaming, low-latency model suggestions (inline completions) + safe tool-calling to update tickets and trigger macros.
OL requirements: must support VPC/private control plane for enterprise banking clients; some national data residency (US & EU).
Latency targets quoted by customer: p50 <= 75ms, p95 <= 180ms under normal load. Will run a synthetic spike to 300 concurrent agents during POC.
Reliability: need graceful degradation for spikes — prefer automatic fallback to a smaller cheaper model with preserved guardrails (no hallucination).

Guardrails: explicit hallucination mitigation required — response provenance + confidence score + templated fallback suggestions. Must support function-calls for ticket update (Zendesk/GitHub/Custom CRM).
Tooling integration: CTI is Twilio Flex; routing and presence info must be available to the model for context. Want an SDK for websocket streaming and token-level cost telemetry.
Cost sensitivity: unit-token cost is important; customer open to quantized model variants for Dedicated to lower GPU costs if output quality retained.
Security & compliance notes: bank customers require SSO/SAML, audit logs retention 7 years for some customers; KMS for key control. Also asked about HSM support for private deployments.
Quote from CTO: 'We need suggestions that are accurate and non-distracting — wrong auto-suggests cost us agent trust.'
POC plan (agreed): 2 weeks, 5 pilot agents -> scale to 50 -> synthetic spike. Deliverables: latency & correctness dashboard, regression tests on canonical prompts, guardrail stress tests.
SE observations: Candidate architecture — Dedicated GPU pool in us-east-1, streaming websocket for low-latency responses, prefix KV cache for repetitive prompts (hold on customer consent).
Open questions: how Redwood handles model routing during zone failover, exact SLA for Dedicated latency, token-level cost dashboards per route, and replay of transcripts for evals.
Next demo: latency under simulated CTI jitter + function-call demo showing ticket patch and agent UI insertion (week of 2024-11-11).
